title: Herondale, Ballinesker, Curracloe, Co Wexford, Y21HY39
seoTitle: Herondale, Ballinesker, Curracloe, Co Wexford, Y21HY39
description:
Herondale could very well be the property you have been waiting years to find......!

The three bedroom detached bungalow is set back from the road on a quiet cul-de-sac which it shares with five other properties.  This home is in walk in condition and is just a two minute walk to the fabulous Ballineskar beach with Curracloe Beach only a few minutes further on.

If you envisage waking up every morning and walking to a magnificent beach for a swim and retuning home for breakfast and "chilling out" you need to view Herondale... The property provides a fantastic and healthy environment for kids to unwind and enjoy long weekends and holiday breaks.

Accommodation comprises 3 bedrooms (main with ensuite and another with "Jack & Jill" access to the family bathroom), livingroom and an open plan living / dining and kitchen area that enjoys access to the rear patio and garden.

Curracloe Village is within a  4 minute drive, Blackwater Village 7 minutes and Wexford Town 15 minutes. The location makes commuting to Dublin easy. Herondale is a perfect permanent, retirement or holiday home and an early viewing is recommended.

Living Room 5.38m x 3.64m. Bright and spacious with wooden flooring and solid fuel stove.

Kitchen / Dining / Living Area Open plan.

Kitchen / Dining Area 4.82m x 3.18m. With waist and eye level storage and tiled flooring.
Opens up into the large, bright. private living area.

Living Area 3.7m x 3.6m. With tiled flooring and lofted ceiling with 2 large Velux Windows. Double doors lead to the rear garden and patio area. The property comes with the benefit of a porch at the rear.

Rear Store 6m x 3.75m. Attached to the house and a great addition to any home.

Corridor 4.1m x 1.02m. With pine flooring.

Bedroom 1 3.25m x 3m

Bedroom 2 Ensuite 3.8m x 2.9m. With wooden flooring.

Ensuite 3.23m x 2.33m. Recent addition, spacious with tiled flooring and part tiled walls, mains shower, w.c. and w.h.b.

Bedroom 3 (Jack & Jill Ensuite) 4.18m x 3.2m. With wooden flooring, enjoys "Jack & Jill access into the bathroom.

Bathroom 2.42m x 1.95m. With tiled flooring and part tiled walls, mains shower, w.c. and w.h.b.
